name: Alistair Humphrey
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the skies. A former RAF aircraft engineer, he transitioned his expertise in aerodynamics and structural integrity to the high-octane world of racing. He spent several years honing his skills with smaller racing outfits before landing a role at Racing Start Academy. 

Alistair is a proponent of data-driven engineering. He believes that meticulous analysis of telemetry and simulation data is the key to unlocking performance gains. His approach is characterized by a relentless pursuit of marginal gains, always seeking innovative solutions to optimize vehicle performance. While technically gifted, he recognizes the importance of human element, and has been focusing on improving his management skills.

What sets Alistair apart is his unwavering focus on the long-term vision. He's not just interested in short-term fixes, but in developing a holistic engineering strategy that will propel Racing Start Academy to sustained success. He has a reputation of spotting talent, and encouraging young engineers to think outside the box, and develop their own ideas.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is a man of medium build, with a thoughtful expression etched on his face.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out engineering handbook with him.
Has a habit of doodling complex aerodynamic diagrams during meetings.
Drinks copious amounts of Earl Grey tea.
